summary: Orphaned SSE chunks after edge idle-probe coalescence leading to missing final sentence
description: Issue summary: Several requests from a single Saturn Analytics customer experience truncated streaming output where the final sentence (period and newline) is missing. The stream ends without the terminal 'end' event for ~1-3% of long responses. Impact: Customer-facing chat UI shows incomplete last sentence; downstream processing that expects a closing delimiter fails, causing truncated transcripts and redundant follow-up requests. Environment: prod-us-east, traffic routed through FastEdge v2.4.1 (our edge), client: browser-based app behind corporate proxy. Steps to reproduce: 1) Start a long completion (>800 tokens) against model redwood/longform-v2 with streaming SSE endpoint and keepalive ping enabled. 2) Allow connection to idle for ~45s until edge idle-probe triggers. 3) Observe stream termination when server finishes generation. Observed behavior: Final sentence either missing or cut at a punctuation boundary; SSE stream closes without a trailing event that contains the last closing punctuation. Reproducible at low rate (~2/200 attempts) under customer traffic. Expected behavior: Stream should include complete final tokens and proper end-event. Logs / evidence: - Customer transcript attached (redacted) showing trailing fragment: "...and we recommend using prefix caching for" then stream ends. - Edge trace (link below) shows an idle-probe probe frame (keepalive) arriving within 20ms of final application chunk. - Packet capture (pcap link) shows TCP segment with probe then trailing chunk coalesced into same record. Links: slack:#support-saturn-310999, dashboard:metrics.redwood.prod/streams/SUP-310999, pcap:S3://redwood-private/pcaps/SUP-310999.pcap

investigation_notes: Edge request logs correlate missing-final events to a short window where an idle keepalive probe (HTTP/1.1 single-byte probe) lands within <=25ms of the final generated chunk.

PCAP analysis: single TCP segment contains keepalive probe then application payload; proxy's TCP write coalescing merges both into same upstream write. On client-side SSE parser we see the final newline delimiter discarded when meta/control byte precedes application bytes in same record.

Reproduction: forcing FastEdge idle-probe in lab consistently triggers truncated final token when the server's final chunk is <512 bytes and arrives within 10-30ms of probe. Not reproduced with FastEdge v2.6.0-edge which has updated coalescing logic.

Hypothesis A: Edge coalescing + client SSE parser treats leading zero-length control cause as malformed chunk and silently drops trailing text. Hypothesis B: Server flush timing interacts with Nagle/delayed ACK causing boundary misinterpretation at proxy.
Telemetry: ~0.7% of Saturn Analytics' long responses flagged. Global rate between 0.1-0.4% across other customers; higher concentration for browsers that keep connections idle >30s.
Related: similar symptoms observed in linked ticket SUP-742900 but that case involved proxy re-write; behaviors differ but coalescing theory aligns.
Config note: currently FastEdge in prod uses TCP_QUICKACK disabled; enabling quickack in lab reduced incidence but not eliminated it.
workaround: Client: Short-term workaround for customer is to reduce idle timeout so edge keepalive does not trigger during generation (set client-side heartbeat every 10s instead of relying on edge).
Server-side: Canary deploy of patch that inserts a zero-width sentinel ("\n\n") before emitting idle-probe susceptible final flush. Test build link: staging.redwood/test-endpoints/SUP-310999
Edge: Plan to roll FastEdge v2.6.0-edge which contains coalescing fixes to reduce merged write conditions.
resolution: Status: In Progress. Temporary workaround provided to customer and test build deployed for verification.

Planned next steps: 1) Validate test build with customer. 2) Schedule production rollout of FastEdge v2.6.0-edge to reduce coalescing risk. 3) Implement server-side sentinel on GA path if edge rollout delayed. 4) Add telemetry rule to detect keepalive-coalesced final-chunk events and alert at 0.3% threshold.
Owner: Evan Brooks (SRE) to coordinate edge rollout; Maya Li to own server sentinel patch and regression tests.
